question_text: $\mathrm{An} \mathrm{Al}_2 \mathrm{O}_3$ whisker is a small single crystal used to reinforce metal-matrix composites. Given a cylindrical shape, calculate the number of Al atoms and the number of O atoms in a whisker with a diameter of $1 \mu \mathrm{~m}$ and a length of $25 \mu \mathrm{~m}$. (The density of $\mathrm{Al}_2 \mathrm{O}_3$ is $3.97 \mathrm{Mg} / \mathrm{m}^3$.) Give your answer as a tuple: (number_of_Al_atoms, number_of_O_atoms).
response:
## Reasoning

**1. Geometry — volume of the cylindrical whisker**

$$V = \pi\!\left(\frac{d}{2}\right)^{\!2} L = \pi\!\left(\frac{1\times10^{-6}}{2}\right)^{\!2}(25\times10^{-6}) = 1.9635\times10^{-17}\ \text{m}^3$$

**2. Mass from density** ($\rho = 3.97\ \text{Mg/m}^3 = 3.97\times10^{3}\ \text{kg/m}^3$)

$$m = \rho V = (3.97\times10^{3})(1.9635\times10^{-17}) = 7.795\times10^{-14}\ \text{kg} = 7.795\times10^{-11}\ \text{g}$$

**3. Moles of Al₂O₃** (molar mass $= 2(26.98)+3(16.00)=101.96\ \text{g/mol}$)

$$n = \frac{m}{M} = \frac{7.795\times10^{-11}}{101.96} = 7.645\times10^{-13}\ \text{mol}$$

**4. Number of formula units** ($N_A = 6.022\times10^{23}$)

$$N_{\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3} = nN_A = 4.604\times10^{11}$$

**5. Atom counts** — each formula unit has 2 Al and 3 O atoms:

$$N_{\text{Al}} = 2N_{\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3} \approx 9.21\times10^{11}, \qquad N_{\text{O}} = 3N_{\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3} \approx 1.38\times10^{12}$$

$$\boxed{(9.21\times10^{11},\ 1.38\times10^{12})}$$
